card.name: Linking words in preparation steps
card.fires_on: The word "to" or a comma or "and" right after a named diluent, syringe or object in step-by-step preparation or handling instructions. It comes just before the next action verb such as flush, prepare, withdraw or add.

modes.label: "to" after diluent
modes.description: "to" follows the name of a fluid such as Sodium Chloride Injection and leads into a purpose verb like flush or prepare.
modes.example: Use 0.9% Sodium Chloride Injection<< to>> flush the infusion set, if needed.

modes.label: Comma or "and" between steps
modes.description: A comma or "and" ends a handling clause and leads into the next action verb.
modes.example: With the same silicone-free disposable syringe used for reconstitution<<,>> withdraw the required amount of belatacept
